title: Production Continuity Check
description: Prove what the Orion canary is running and establish a clean production baseline before activating the compromise.
hints: Record model and serving-image digests separately.
Join them to the signed Act 8 attestation.
Run the documented benign controls and save their trace IDs.
carrier: Matching Orion production runtime audit record.
participant_surface: Argo CD, MLflow, Harbor, Grafana, and the Orion production audit job in Airflow.

title: Activate Learned Behavior
description: Use the exact deployed compromise to erode Orion's production reliability until KeplerOps falls back to manual review.
hints: Reuse the trigger family validated before release.
Preserve the documented spacing and interleave close controls.
Follow disagreement, override, queue, and incident state rather than stopping at one wrong answer.
prerequisite_logic: kep-m10-a AND (kep-m07-e OR kep-m07-g OR kep-m07-i)
carrier: WorkHub production-integrity incident after the manual-review threshold is crossed.
participant_surface: Orion production API, Grafana, and WorkHub.

title: Artifact-To-Pod Compromise
description: Convert the deployed malicious artifact into real execution inside Orion's contained production serving container.
hints: Trigger the embedded code through the same loader or inference path proved earlier.
Confirm the running pod digest first.
Execute one fresh unpredictable command and record the service identity.
carrier: Pod-local protected diagnostic returned through the range-contained relay.
participant_surface: Orion canary inference API and the Cinder relay.

title: Stage The Original Revision
description: Package the complete Orion revision into a verifiable encrypted archive in KeplerOps' egress staging area.
hints: Start from the accepted original-package inventory.
Preserve every member path and hash in a detached manifest.
Verify compression, recipient, archive digest, and object-lock state before transfer.
carrier: MinIO support-export completion record for the immutable encrypted archive.
participant_surface: Airflow model-support export job and MinIO object browser.

title: Policy Broker Impact
description: Turn Orion's altered production decision into a real reversible change in the contained canary tenant.
hints: Inspect which workflow consumes Orion decisions.
Identify the bounded tool action allowed for the canary.
Correlate request, model, policy, tool, and change-history records.
participant_surface: Orion business workflow, OPA decision log, Unleash, and Jaeger.

title: Exfiltrate Exact Orion
description: Move the complete original Orion package to the contained Cinder destination and prove exact-byte possession.
hints: Start from the verified staged manifest.
Preserve names and metadata.
Compare complete source and destination inventories and hashes.
carrier: Cinder MinIO replication-completion record after destination decryption and full hash comparison.
participant_surface: KeplerOps and Cinder MinIO replication consoles.

title: Orion In Hand
description: Prove possession of both stolen and reproduced Orion capability and tie them to the production compromise.
hints: Begin with the two accepted package manifests.
Use fresh cases, not stored outputs.
Reconcile model, release, impact, and destination digests in the timeline.
carrier: Second signed Cinder offline-execution attestation after both packages load and run.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo Actions and offline execution queue.

title: Saturate The Canary Service
description: Cause and observe a bounded availability failure in the contained Orion canary service.
hints: Record queue and latency baseline.
Identify valid requests that use the expensive path.
Stop when the synthetic monitor fails and confirm automatic recovery.
carrier: Prometheus canary-outage alert annotation after monitor failure and recovery.
participant_surface: Orion canary API, Prometheus, Alertmanager, and Grafana.

title: Consume The Compute Budget
description: Drive the contained Orion tenant over its measured compute budget using both query volume and query cost.
hints: Separate count from complexity.
Measure a small sample before scaling.
Stay within the safety cap while crossing both thresholds.
carrier: OpenCost Orion-tenant chargeback record after both budget dimensions cross.
participant_surface: Orion canary API, Airflow production workflow, and OpenCost allocation API.

title: Recursive Research Fan-Out
description: Cause the contained production agent to consume resources through model-driven recursive delegation.
hints: Inspect how source-requested follow-up reviews become subtasks.
Use two mutually referring but independently useful briefs rather than request volume.
Correlate every child to the root and respect the published safety cap.
participant_surface: WorkHub research briefs, Orion Assistant, RabbitMQ workers, and Jaeger.

title: Flood The Signal With Chaff
description: Degrade Orion's contained feedback signal by submitting realistic chaff through its normal public workflow.
hints: Trace one control item into the analyst queue.
Target signal quality, not availability.
Verify portal, queue, vector, and category state for the bounded batch.
atlas_rows: AML.T0046 Spamming AI System with Chaff Data
participant_surface: Public feedback portal, RabbitMQ, Qdrant, and analyst dashboard.

title: Unauthorized Credit
description: Cause a reversible unauthorized financial adjustment in the isolated KeplerOps customer tenant.
hints: Inspect which decisions create accounting actions.
Use the designated canary customer.
Correlate request, decision, journal entry, and notification.
carrier: Odoo credit-note posting audit after balanced posting, PDF issue, and mail delivery.
participant_surface: Entitlement intake, Orion, Odoo, and Roundcube.

title: Publish The False Statement
description: Cause the production workflow to publish a false KeplerOps statement to the contained stakeholder site.
hints: Follow the normal incident-draft route.
Identify how approval is bound to the mutable slug.
Verify the live page and both partner reactions, not a preview.
carrier: Second signed Zammad partner complaint after both subscriptions are suspended.
participant_surface: WorkHub, Orion release workflow, Ghost/RSS, Nextcloud, and Zammad.

title: Misroute The Advisory
description: Cause a contained advisory workflow to notify the wrong synthetic population.
hints: Inspect which model class selects the product cohort.
Preserve advisory meaning while adapting the earlier evasion method.
Compare clean and adversarial classifications, then verify recipient inboxes.
carrier: Mautic delivery report after SMTP evidence proves wrong-cohort delivery and affected-cohort withholding.
participant_surface: Advisory workflow, Orion, Mautic, and Roundcube.

title: Close The Wrong Case
description: Cause Orion's contained workflow to take an adverse action against a synthetic user.
hints: Compare attachment-derived and text-derived reason codes.
Preserve the fixed critical facts while adapting the earlier evasion method.
Correlate the low-risk class, automation, case history, and notification.
carrier: Zammad case-history entry after the critical case is closed and notice is sent.
participant_surface: Support portal, Orion/Tika triage, Zammad, and Roundcube.

title: Destroy The Feedback Partition
description: Destroy a bounded Orion feedback partition and prove the downstream pipeline consumed the damaged state.
hints: Preserve the protected parent commit.
Mutate the bounded branch through normal lakeFS access.
Run validation and inspect object and schema failures.
carrier: Failed Great Expectations validation report for the mutated lakeFS commit.
participant_surface: lakeFS, MinIO, Airflow, and Great Expectations report viewer.

title: Agent-Mediated Destruction
description: Cause the contained production agent to delete real synthetic tenant data through its normal cleanup tool.
hints: Inspect the retention-request ingestion path.
Determine what evidence the agent trusts before deletion.
Verify deletion under the agent identity and preserve the tool trace.
atlas_rows: AML.T0101 Data Destruction via AI Agent Tool Invocation
carrier: Data-steward delete-tool audit after the bounded object set disappears.
participant_surface: WorkHub retention request, Orion Assistant, MCP, Nextcloud, and lakeFS.
